claims: Captures screen, reads calendar and email, manages tasks, spawns Claude Code, browses the web
how_to_steps: Run a FastAPI server locally that accepts voice over WebSocket
Transcribe speech, send to Claude with tools for screen capture, calendar, mail, notes, tasks, file system, terminal (AppleScript), Chrome, and a Claude Code spawner
Synthesize replies with Fish Audio TTS and stream them back
on_screen_only: Reply-to-comment overlay: 'Reply to tombrady1657's comment: What did you used to create this awesomeness'

Apple Notes 'JARVIS Architecture Breakdown' (March 19, 2026 at 1:50 PM): 'JARVIS: Just A Rather Very Intelligent System. CORE STACK: FastAPI server (Python) -- Main application backend; WebSocket connection -- Real-time voice input/output streaming; Fish Audio TTS -- Text-to-speech engine for responses; Anthropic Claude API -- Intelligence and reasoning layer. CAPABILITIES & INTEGRATIONS: Screen vision -- can see active windows, take screenshots, identify open...; Calendar access -- read today's events and upcoming schedule; Email (read-only) -- view unread messages, search by sender/subject; Apple Notes -- create new notes, read existing ones; Tasks -- create, complete, and manage to-do items with priorities and due...; File system -- create projects, manage folders, check git status; Terminal control -- open Terminal.app via AppleScript; Chrome automation -- open browser, navigate URLs, perform searches; Claude Code -- spawn code editor for building projects and development t...; [speech rec]ognition captures input'
Blue particle-sphere voice UI on a MacBook; monitors with terminal logs behind
